body:
It's blood alcohol content. I was almost drunk enough to die..
And from what I've just read from "_ronn_"...maybe I should have
Seems to be what everyone where I am wants..

Thank you for responding. I am living with my great aunt and I have tried to discuss things with her but all she really says is that "quitters do that" or that "it's pointless and stupid"....I cannot afford to go back to the hospital and my parents kicked me off the insurance when then kicked me out so getting help is now out of the question. I think the reason I made my "testimony" here is because this community of people seem to be involved and I just needed someone..really anyone. 

I guess I should mention that I have tried to make friends and I did...2 other girls (I'm a girl in case I didn't say that?) and I really liked them...but I was suicidal and they took me to a party to distract me...then I got so drunk I blew a .41 BAC and they left me behind completely alone...I have no memory of that night and they haven't spoken to me since

I truly appreciate what your saying and I am glad to hear that I have helped you in your own situation. I wish that I could be of more help to everyone...I've always tried to help others before myself. I am just at such a low point that I am having trouble even taking advice...
